Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.8: Repeat Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) at the Same Level

Required findings: Greater than six (6) months elapsed since the prior lumbar fusion
Daily pain of clinically significant intensity causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, inability to stand for prolonged periods)
Physical examination findings that are concordant with the reported symptoms

Failure of BOTH (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs for a minimum of six (6) weeks AND a provider‑directed exercise/physical‑therapy program for a minimum of six (6) weeks
Post‑operative imaging performed at no less than six (6) months after the prior fusion that demonstrates pseudoarthrosis at the requested level(s)
Post‑operative MRI or CT that corroborates the pseudoarthrosis and aligns with the patient’s symptoms
Absence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, opioid use disorder, secondary gain)

Documentation of nicotine‑free status: either never‑smoker or abstinence from all tobacco/nicotine products for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery verified by an objective cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range for the testing method
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.8: Repeat Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) at the Same Level > Symptomatic Pseudoarthrosis

Non-Indications: Less than six (6) months since the prior lumbar fusion
Pain that is mild, intermittent, or does not cause functional limitation
Physical exam not consistent with pseudoarthrosis
Absence of imaging evidence of pseudoarthrosis on studies performed ≥6 months post‑op
Adequate symptom relief after a trial of prescription analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, NSAIDs, and/or physical therapy of at least six (6) weeks
Presence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Active tobacco use without documented six‑week cessation or without a normal cotinine test
Contraindication to the required conservative therapy trials preventing their completion
Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine abstinence must be confirmed by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) performed within a clinically appropriate window before surgery
If either the medication trial or the physical‑therapy trial is medically contraindicated, the requirement for that specific trial may be waived, but documentation of the contraindication is required
All imaging demonstrating pseudoarthrosis must be obtained at least six (6) months after the index fusion to ensure true non‑union
Both medication and exercise therapy must be attempted for the full six‑week duration unless a documented medical contraindication exists
Documentation required: Operative report of the original lumbar fusion (including level(s) fused)
Post‑operative plain radiographs (including flexion‑extension views) or CT performed ≥6 months after the index surgery showing pseudoarthrosis
MRI or CT report confirming pseudoarthrosis and correlating with the patient’s symptoms
Comprehensive physical examination note documenting neurologic and musculoskeletal findings consistent with pseudoarthrosis
Pain assessment documentation (e.g., pain scores, functional limitation description) demonstrating daily clinically significant pain
Pharmacy or medication administration records showing ≥6 weeks of prescription‑strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs
Physical therapy or supervised exercise program records showing ≥6 weeks of participation with documented goals and progress
Behavioral health evaluation note confirming no unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Smoking cessation documentation: either a statement of never‑smoker status or a recent objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal limits
Any prior imaging (pre‑fusion) for baseline comparison, if available
